mechanism: Three individual source bottom edges in the lower grey L receive red/blue/orange identities, each matched to its +4-column translated bottom edge. This unit-edge correspondence replaces the first design whole-L grouping: it individually binds source(0,1)→(4,1), source(1,1)→(5,1), source(0,0)→E(4,0). The intended misconception is translation instead of reflection, leaving C apparently uncovered while E is falsely covered. No new line,fill or text is added.
mathematical_solution: Use cells (column,row) from the lower-left corner. The grey cells are (1,3),(2,3),(2,2),(0,1),(1,1),(0,0). Reflection in x=3 sends column c to5-c, preserving row, so destinations are (4,3),(3,3),(3,2),(5,1),(4,1),(5,0). Letter positions are A=(3,3), B=(4,3), C=(5,0), D=(4,1), E=(4,0). A/B/C/D are covered; E alone is not. No colored border changes the grey set, the fold, or a letter coordinate, so E remains unique. The false translation targets (4,1),(5,1),(4,0) for the lower L and incorrectly omits C.
marker_roles: Red original lower-L grey cell(0,1) bottomedge identifies the first individual source member.
Red target bottomedge at(4,1) binds this destination to source(0,1) by the wrong +4 translation.
Blue original grey cell(1,1) bottomedge identifies the source horizontal-arm member.
Blue target bottomedge at(5,1) binds the horizontal-arm member by the same wrong translation.
Orange original grey cell(0,0) bottomedge identifies the decisive bottom source member.
Orange E-cell bottomedge at(4,0) binds E to source(0,0), despite its true mirror image being C(5,0).
human_gate: Only six existing unit bottom edges are recolored1.5pt. All original source outlines and six greyfills remain, and every letter is entirely unobscured. The black thick fold and all gridline lengths are unchanged. Three colored edge pairs preserve individual source-to-destination identities; colors do not establish a new formal mapping rule.
limits: No original control or statistical marker ablation. Any two wrong calls would establish only this frozen candidate possibility, pending NEW independent second review.
